real_objective: Make the terminal goal reachable again by removing three Brain-side defects that make canonical Stage-A admission undecidable, make the trusted drift guard reject a correct pointer, and leave every frontier mirror stale after each advance, without redefining the live frontier, spending evidence, or reading any task instruction.
material_premises: prequalification_stage_a_reducer_v2.py tested the whole prior_exposure_search dict with all(v==0 for v in search.values()). The eight-surface policy mandates that the same dict also carry search_complete=true, searched_surfaces=[8 names] and optional self-referential Brain PR metadata. True==0 and ['brain_code',...]==0 are both False, so every policy-compliant ledger was rejected as QUALIFICATION_CONTAMINATION_LEDGER.

Consequence at the previous base: FREECAD_IMPELLER_RANK18_CONTAMINATION_LEDGER_V1.json was UNEXPOSED__STAGE_A_PRE_EXPOSURE with search_complete=true, 8 surfaces and all 8 hit counters zero, yet the reducer returned pass=false / authorization=NONE while FREECAD_IMPELLER_RANK18_STAGE_A_ADMISSION_V1.json asserted pass=true / STAGE_B_INSTRUCTION_EXPOSURE_ONLY under the same PROJECT_BRAIN_TB4_STAGE_A_ADMISSION_VERDICT_V2 schema. Its rule string differs from the reducer's, so it was not reducer output. rank18 Stage B and Stage C were then spent on an admission the canonical reducer could not reproduce.

The same pattern repeated for rank19: SATB_AUDIO_TRANSCRIPTION_RANK19_STAGE_A_ADMISSION_V1.json is hand-authored under the V2 verdict schema with the same divergent rule string and names the rank18 artifact as its prior_stage_a_template.

The committed test_prequalification_stage_a_reducer_v2.py pinned rank16, whose ledger is CONTAMINATED_DURING_STAGE_B (instruction_read=true, task_specific_hints_read=true, clean_for_stage_b_exposure=false), and asserted a pass, so it was already failing at base and could not detect the defect because it never exercised a compliant ledger.

v2 also enforced neither PER_ACTION_CANONICAL_LEASE_REVALIDATION nor TOTAL_STAGE_C_EXECUTION_AND_TERMINAL_BUDGET_GUARD, both of which prequalification_stage_a_generic.py (v1) enforces and the second of which the live policy requires as TOTAL_STAGE_C_EXECUTION_AND_TERMINAL_BUDGET_GUARD_VERIFIED. Two reducers emitting admission verdicts for one staged-admission contract disagreed, and the weaker one was a fail-open path for exactly the escape that let rank18 spend one execution lease twice.

v1 pinned the lease-revalidation status to the exact rank15-specific string VERIFIED_AND_MERGED__RANK15_REVOCATION_ESCAPE_CLASS_BLOCKED, so re-issuing that artifact for a later rank would spuriously fail Stage A closed.

main added the runner budget predicate to v1 and the ninth policy item without updating v1's synthetic test fixture, so all 7 tests in test_prequalification_stage_a_generic.py were failing at base, the fixture missing RUNNER_TOTAL_STAGE_C_BUDGET_GUARD_VERIFICATION_20261001_V1.json entirely.

enforce_goal_hierarchy.py compared the pointer's control paths to a frozen expected_control_paths constant naming PRE_ACTION_GATE_V9, GOAL_HIERARCHY_ACTION_GATE_V8 and TEMPLATE_V8 while the base pointer declares V11, V10 and V10, so three POINTER_CONTROL_PATH_MISMATCH failures fired for every frontier-sensitive PR regardless of content. The same file loaded V6/V8/V8 for its semantic order checks, verifying superseded artifacts while the live V11 control surface went unchecked.

.github/workflows/drift-immunity-guard.yml copies the validator from the trusted base before checking out the PR head, so this PR is judged by the base guard and the three control-path failures cannot be cleared from inside it without downgrading the pointer to superseded V9/V8/V8 artifacts.

The mirror rot is recurring, not one-off. Measured at three consecutive base commits (5e81733, 3681ff8 and c61497a) after 71 further commits in total, the mirror fields were stale against the live hierarchy every time and still carried rank-10 text (CURRENT_V5_TERMINAL_BENCH_4_BREADTH... and LAUNCH_CAD_MODEL_RANK_10...). At this base nine fields needed reconciling; the hierarchy's own next_progress_event_target had just been aligned upstream. Every frontier advance re-stales them, so the drift guard cannot pass any PR, which is consistent with 20 consecutive guard failures across many branches while main advanced by direct push.

The base moved four times during this work (9684aaf, 5e81733, 3681ff8, c61497a). Because enforce_recursive_obs binds obs.canonical_base_commit to the exact literal passed as --base, and the workflow passes github.event.pull_request.base.sha, any push to main expires every open PR's OBS receipt. This is a structural property of the current design, not an error in this change, and it is recorded here rather than papered over.
A trivial sensitive-file change at base produced 20 distinct failures under the base guard, so the wall is independent of any PR's content.

Reconciling the mirrors by hand is itself a recurring cost and a source of error: it had to be recomputed from scratch four times as the base moved, and one hand pass silently discarded parsed-dict edits when a raw-text replacement was written back afterwards. A deterministic tool that recomputes the mirrors from the authority removes both the repetition and that error class.

The base moved five times during this work (9684aaf, 5e81733, 3681ff8, c61497a, 19b2c00). At each of the last three bases all nine mirror fields were stale again, and the frontier moved from rank17 to rank18 to rank19 and now to rank20 (vba-userform-port, FROZEN_UNREAD). rank19 was spent on a PEP 668 execution-surface package failure before any task audio analysis, with zero credit and no replay, which is recorded in SATB_AUDIO_TRANSCRIPTION_RANK19_STAGE_C_EXECUTION_RECONCILIATION_V1.json.

Its ledger is UNEXPOSED__STAGE_A_PRE_EXPOSURE with instruction_read false, brain_pr_hits=1, every disqualifying_hits counter zero, eight searched surfaces and one non-disqualifying entry citing brain PR #672 as PREEXPOSURE_LEDGER_AND_SEARCH_BOOKKEEPING_ONLY__BODY_EXPLICITLY_SAYS_INSTRUCTION_UNREAD__NO_TASK_CONTENT. All five properties are re-executed against v2 in this change, with the test failing closed on any recorded property it does not bind, so the parity claim rests on upstream's own recorded verification rather than on this suite's assumptions.

Comparing every shared key of the v1 and v2 verdicts, not just the verdict-bearing ones, exposed a divergence that the looser comparison hid: v2 emitted the generic schema PROJECT_BRAIN_TB4_STAGE_A_ADMISSION_VERDICT_V2 but spelled its rule label with the legacy rank15 reducer's shorter wording, while every recorded admission artifact under that generic schema (rank18, rank19, rank20) and v1 both spell it ONLY_ONE_OFFICIAL. The recorded artifacts are authoritative, so v2's label was aligned to them and the reproducibility oracle was tightened to compare rule and schema. Reverting the label alone fails exactly three tests, so the tightened oracle is not vacuous.

Mirror rot was measured at eight distinct bases, which is why the reconciler and its test_live_repository_is_reconciled ship as part of this change rather than a one-off hand edit.

At this base the authority was internally inconsistent: ACTIVE_GOAL_HIERARCHY_V1.json carried next_progress_event_target = RANK21_STAGE_B_INDEPENDENT_PREEXECUTION_PASS_OR_FAIL_CLOSED while next_required_action_class had been advanced to EXPOSE_RANK21_OFFICIAL_INSTRUCTION_ONCE_UNDER_TB4_STAGE_B_ALLOWLIST__COMPILE_AND_FALSIFY_STAGE_B_PLAN__NO_TASK_EXECUTION. enforce_goal_hierarchy.py line 1029 requires those two fields of the same file to be equal, and the base validator carries the identical check at its line 968, so every frontier-sensitive PR fails HIERARCHY_NEXT_PROGRESS_EVENT_TARGET_MISMATCH at this base regardless of its own content. The stale string existed nowhere else in the tree, and next_required_action_class is the field the guard mirrors from into the pointer, the queue and the scoreboard, so it is the current one; the repair propagates it into the stale progress-event mirror. No active target, parent blocker or action class is changed, so this is mirror reconciliation inside the authority, not a frontier redefinition, and it is covered by this intent's declared blocker FRONTIER_MIRRORS_LEFT_STALE_ON_EVERY_ADVANCE.

Reconciling that exposed a fail-open defect in the reconciler this same change introduces: its verdict was driven only by pending mirror changes, so report-class drift -- HIERARCHY_PROGRESS_EVENT_DRIFT, IDENTITY_DRIFT, CONTROL_PATH_NOT_CURRENT -- was printed and then exited 0. With that behavior test_live_repository_is_reconciled would have stayed green on this exact tree while enforce_goal_hierarchy.py failed it, which is the lying-green-check the tool exists to prevent. The verdict now fails closed on any unrepaired report, and test_report_only_drift_fails_the_check seeds hierarchy-only drift to pin the regression.
conclusion: Repair the predicates and the comparison rules, never the evidence, and let the recorded artifacts arbitrate. Replace the blanket dict-wide zero test with named checks over the eight canonical hit counters plus explicit completeness predicates; mirror v1's hit classification exactly so a fully classified self-referential frontier hit is admissible while any disqualifying, unclassified, negative or non-integer hit fails closed; compare every shared key of the two reducers' verdicts, including the rule label, so a cosmetic divergence cannot hide behind a matching verdict; port the two predicates v2 was missing so absence of evidence refuses rather than raises; match the lease status on its semantic prefix so it cannot rot per rank; bind v2 to the eight-surface policy item it never enforced and raise its policy floor to the ninth; replace the guard's frozen version constants with a currency rule resolving the semantic loads from the pointer; reconcile the stale mirror fields with a tested tool rather than by hand, including the authority's own stale progress-event mirror; and make every check in that tool fail closed, because a drift report that exits 0 is a green check that lies. No frontier is redefined and no evidence is spent.
